notes.title: Nightmare Hunter Update Notice #1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42473765/9d9abd61678d2fcb6f5c3acc05ba26809eca1ad7.png[/img]
[h1]It's an update notice![/h1]

[h2]Hi supporters.[/h2]
We are Spread Labs.
Ah... Everyone was so busy living in the present life that they forgot about game development and modification at all.
Life is real, isn't it? ( ;>ㅂ<;)

So we apologize to our players for being lazy.  ( _ _) (_ _ )

Nevertheless, we decided to renew our game called Nightmare Hunter!
That's why I'm informing you of the changing notice below.


[h3]1.Engine Update[/h3]
We are replacing the current game developed as an existing game maker studio with Unity.

[h3]2.Graphics Update[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42473765/f600017d7c9b183a3163b7fd39337c25fb840692.gif[/img]
well... The play screen below is better than the previous picture drawn above, right?
We will revise it as soon as possible.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42473765/64160521e358bcfa9dc06f81f05590a9bedea5a2.gif[/img]

We're working hard on producing it, so please look forward to it!

[h3]3.It will be changed to the existing $1 -> 3 dollars.[/h3]
Oh! I forgot the most important thing.
It will be increased from 1 dollar, or 1 dollar to 3 dollars.
[Laughing].. It was inevitable because it took a lot of hard work and trouble..
If you've already put it on the steam list, it'll be very helpful if you purchase it in advance

then.
I'll see you in the next update news.
The expected completion date of the update is the end of June.

Thank you.
